scope: Targeted follow-up of four cluster-07 open comparisons. Read eleven complete current runtime exchanges and their five speaking goals. This is not a whole-prefecture or whole-corpus certification.

targets.reason: Kashima corrects annual expenditure entered as monthly expenditure, annotates intervals, distinguishes monthly provisioning from the actual April debit. Nagai corrects replacement/subtraction of an additional bonus payment, explicitly recalculates 10000 + 30000 and separates arithmetic from contractual billing. Their middle tasks and outcomes differ; a generic financial clarification theme is not sufficient to establish reuse.
targets.remainingScope: Other recurring-expense scripts and the completed Ibaraki corpus remain to be reviewed.

targets.reason: Itako reconstructs missed exemption conditions, distinguishes transaction channels, asks how to establish an unknown monthly usage count, then waits for applicable pricing. Misawa supplies a fixed fee and adjusts coin quantities to a budget; Tomiya separates transfer principal from total account debit after payment; Bibai obtains overseas beneficiary information and asks about FX/fees before sending. These are different requested actions and resolutions.
targets.remainingScope: This selected comparison does not exclude other fee-eligibility overlaps.

targets.reason: Both begin with preparing reading material before boarding, use a side area without obstructing the passage, rearrange items, specify that reading waits until seated or uncrowded, and finish by stowing belongings and attending to departure announcements. Newspaper centre-page reassembly changes the object-specific middle detail but retains the main five-task causal trajectory.

alignedFunctions.function: Prepare reading material before boarding rather than handling it after boarding.
Rearrange belongings/paper while keeping the passage clear.
Decide when reading is appropriate inside the train.
Finish stowing items and attend to boarding/departure guidance.

targets.requiredAction: Replace the entire Moriya exchange and all five speaking goals with a distinct station problem and resolution; changing the reading material alone is insufficient. Preserve IDs, chain and index. Rerun canonical/source/runtime parity and targeted causal comparison.

targets.reason: Gift-bag versus transport-container roles and asking the recipient about folding the gift bag provide a different middle action from immobilising fragile pottery or taping a poster tube. However all retain the procedural arc of inadequate packing, inspecting a physical defect, correcting packing, handling the address, then dimensions/weight or service selection. The selected evidence supports a substantive middle-task difference but does not justify closing the no-recipe-reuse concern.
targets.requiredAction: Assess the packing group together with Shimotsuma embroidery and the completed Ibaraki corpus. If reuse is rejected at the group level, replace the causal problem and requested actions rather than changing parcel contents.
